write_up: Your resume points toward desktop support, with a school help desk internship and earlier device work at Peachtree Electronics. It's common for an early-career resume to list the tasks without saying much about how often you did them or what they involved. Here, that leaves a recruiter with little to compare against other support applicants.

The Active Directory line is your best model: it names both the account work and the tool. Your last dated job ended in May 2025, and your certification is dated 2025; the resume doesn't say what you've done since. Education also sits above your work, even though you have experience to lead with.
Let's start with the Chattahoochee County Schools tickets and laptops. Add the kinds of issues and the volume you can confirm, then give the time after your internship an honest date and description.
